items.statement: The computed hull supports a multistate sodium insertion pathway in the NASICON framework.
items.expected: Final conclusion identifies the stable phase sequence supported by the submitted hull and distinguishes unstable compositions from hull states.

items.statement: Energy-derived voltage plateaus correspond to successive transition-metal redox regions.
items.expected: The report connects the plateau sequence to V4+/V3+, Ti4+/Ti3+ and V3+/V2+ without confusing computed and measured values.

items.statement: Endpoint volume comparison provides evidence for low structural strain during sodium cycling.
items.expected: The report states the source-supported low-strain interpretation and its limitations.
